tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Primary. Warm paper, the ground of every page, with a fine grain on top (see README, Paper).

tokens.name: paper-lift
tokens.usage: Cards only: quotes, projects, record sleeves, the turntable. Always with a `hair` border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary. Text, headings, every drawn line, the focus ring. 15.6:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: summaries, dates, captions, margin notes. 5.0:1 on `paper`, 5.4:1 on `paper-lift`.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines: list dividers, card borders. Also the card hover shadow.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Primary. The one green: tendril leaves, the backlinks glyph, "playing". 6.7:1 on `paper`, safe for text.

tokens.name: green-deep
tokens.usage: The footer, and nothing else. `paper` on it is 9.6:1.

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Illustration only: the gate drawing, map trees, a second tendril leaf. Never text.

tokens.name: green-mid
tokens.usage: Illustration only: the arch and hedges in the gate drawing, the map border.

tokens.name: spot
tokens.usage: Accent. Pink: link underlines, the active nav item, the one flower, the vinyl label, the selected sleeve. Never text (2.8:1). Never in the same component as `sun`.

tokens.name: spot-soft
tokens.usage: The J of the KJ logo. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Environmental. Sky seen through the gate, water on the map. Nothing else. Ink on it is 10.4:1.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Highlight. The recently-tended dot. Never text, never next to pink.

tokens.name: sun-wash
tokens.usage: Highlighter behind one phrase per page.

tokens.name: path
tokens.usage: Illustration only: the path through the gate, the map paths' edges.

tokens.name: lawn
tokens.usage: Map ground only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: A garden I tend in public.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page H1 and article titles (60px on articles). SOFT 50, WONK 1.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: H2 inside a page. SOFT 40, WONK 0.

styles.name: subheading
styles.sample: The résumé is a compression artifact
styles.usage: List titles: a note, a project. Also the record title. SOFT 40.

styles.name: translit
styles.usage: Transliteration on the Quotes page only.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I keep a garden here instead of a feed.
styles.usage: All running text. Articles go to 18.5px at 1.7. Max measure 36rem.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small section labels in `muted` ("2026", "Terms of the garden"). Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates in lists and under titles, in `muted`. "Tended 5 Oct", "Planted March 2026".

styles.name: note
styles.sample: still not sure if this is a complaint or a design brief
styles.usage: Annotation only: one margin note per article, the gate caption, the footer signoff. Never rotated.

styles.name: note-s
styles.sample: the gate opens onto a map, if you like wandering
styles.usage: The caption under the gate drawing.

styles.name: deva
styles.usage: Original-script quotes. Load on the Quotes page only.

tokens.name: space-3

tokens.usage: Minimum page side gutter; tight card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and tile padding.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-7

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Cards and sleeves. Square.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: The turntable plinth only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The recency dot, the record.

tokens.usage: Card hover only, with a 2px lift. Nothing has a shadow at rest.

tokens.usage: Running text and article bodies.
